image_qa.note: The alcohol record, grow-light comparison, and CSS delivery update use text, tables, forms, and existing design components. No product, medical, cultivar, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The September 7–October 4 report showed 1,214 impressions, two clicks, 0.2% CTR, and average position 35.3. Stem Cell CBG had the only supported position 4–20 page signal, with 13 impressions, one click, and position 5.3, and it was materially expanded on October 8. Remaining position 4–20 rows had only one to seven impressions, so no Data-led item was justified. Those tiny samples and the isolated Oklahoma-law click were deliberately ignored; today's work expands distinct safety and lawful-equipment authority and fixes a delivery bottleneck instead of chasing a cosmetic query variation.

authority.action: Rebuilt the cannabis-and-alcohol page into a citation-worthy two-substance exposure, symptom, and responder-handoff record using current CDC, NIAAA, and Poison Control sources; connected it reciprocally to driving, hosting, and urgent-response paths; and strengthened the lawful home-grow cluster with a three-model light-cost comparison. No outreach was sent and no new outreach target was logged because the site's own safety and cultivation clusters presented the higher-value authority work.
